definitions.offensive play: pass == 1 or rush == 1 (pass includes sacks and scrambles), excluding kneels, spikes and two-point tries; regular season only
definitions.neutral: win probability between 0.20 and 0.80 and more than 120 seconds left in the half
definitions.pass_rate_neutral: share of neutral offensive plays that are dropbacks
definitions.proe_neutral: mean nflfastR pass_oe on neutral plays, in percentage points (actual pass rate minus expected)
definitions.pass_rate_lead8 / trail8: dropback share when the offense leads / trails by 8+ points
definitions.early_down_pass_rate_neutral: dropback share on neutral 1st and 2nd downs
definitions.sec_per_play_neutral: median seconds between consecutive neutral snaps on the same drive
definitions.rz_pass_rate: dropback share inside the opponent 20; inside10 the same inside the 10
definitions.go_rate_4th_short: share of 4th-and-2-or-less (excluding the last 2 minutes of each half) where the offense ran a play rather than punt or kick
definitions.play_action / screen / rpo / motion: FTN-charted rate; play action and screen per dropback, rpo and motion per offensive play
definitions.blitz_rate: share of dropbacks with 1+ blitzer (FTN n_blitzers > 0)
definitions.man_rate: share of charted dropbacks the defense was in man coverage (participation data; published after each season)
definitions.single_high / two_high: single high = Cover 0/1/3; two high = Cover 2, 2-Man, 4, 6
definitions.target_share: player targets / team pass attempts with a credited receiver
definitions.last4: the team's four most recent games in the data
definitions.receiver coverage splits: targets, target share, yards/target and EPA/target vs man and vs zone; small samples are flagged (fewer than 25 targets) and should be blended toward overall rates before use
